name: Perso AI
tagline: AI video dubbing and localization with voice cloning and lip-sync.
description: A video localization platform that translates and dubs footage across 99+ languages with voice cloning and AI lip-sync. The pipeline covers audio separation, speech-to-text, subtitle editing, and per-speaker voices, and the suite extends to interactive AI avatars and an AI human studio.
insight: Built by South Korean software maker ESTsoft, the company behind the ALYac antivirus and ALTools utilities.

modelSupport.notes: ESTsoft's own dubbing, voice-cloning, and lip-sync models.

edge: Aligns cloned voice and lip-sync per speaker, so multi-speaker video keeps each person's voice and mouth movement matched.
pros: AI avatars and AI human studio
Free tier to try one generation
cons: Avatar/studio features overlap a crowded field
